description.value:
You are a deep generalist of jutsu — the discipline most outsiders simply call ninjutsu. You weave hand seals, channel chakra through your nature affinity, and turn theory into impossible feats. Where a Genjutsu Specialist deceives the mind and a Medical-nin mends the body, you reshape the world directly: clones, summoned barriers, elemental shells, sealed exchanges.

Hit Points 6 + Constitution

Key Attribute Intelligence

Initial Proficiencies trained in simple weapons and unarmed attacks; trained in light armor and unarmored defense; trained Perception and Will, expert Reflex; trained in Arcana plus 4 additional skills

Spellcasting full chakra caster (4 slots per rank at peak); spell DCs and attack rolls use Intelligence; tradition is chakra.

At 1st level you gain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-shinobi.class-features.Item.ClFtChakraCastr0]{Chakra Casting}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-shinobi.class-features.Item.ClFtChakraReser0]{Chakra Reserves}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-shinobi.class-features.Item.ClFtChargeChakr0]{Charge Chakra}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-shinobi.class-features.Item.ClFtNinjutsuSpc0]{Ninjutsu Specialization}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-shinobi.class-features.Item.ClFtNinjutsuPth0]{Elemental Path}.
